name: Fluttershy
source: A pegasus pony with a light yellow body, cyan eyes and a pink mane and tail. She speaks in a high-pitched, soft squeaky voice. She is sweet and calm, but often very shy around others. However, she can become forceful and assertive if her friends are placed in danger. Fluttershy loves and cares for all animals and is willing to help them at any cost, but is very fearful of many things. Although she is a pegasus, she prefers to stay close to the ground, living in a cottage near the Everfree Forest instead of the sky city of Cloudsdale with the other pegasus ponies. Fluttershy represents the Element of Kindness.
